syn: GENERAL: Inflammation of the appendix (including perforated/complicated appendicitis, appendiceal abscess). Also called: Acute appendicitis

name: Bowel dilatation
syn: GENERAL: Dilated small or large bowel loops (including obstruction, ileus, megacolon, megarectum). Also called: Bowel distension; Dilated bowel loops

name: Bowel obstruction
syn: GENERAL: Mechanical obstruction of small or large bowel (including strangulating, closed-loop, adhesive). Also called: Intestinal obstruction

name: Diverticular disease
syn: GENERAL: Diverticulosis or diverticulitis of the colon. Also called: Colonic diverticular disease

name: Faecal impaction
syn: GENERAL: Impacted faeces in the colon/rectum (faecaloma). Also called: Faecaloma; Faecal loading

name: Gastrointestinal wall thickening
syn: GENERAL: Thickening of the oesophageal, gastric, small bowel or colonic wall of any cause (including colitis, enteritis, proctitis).

name: Hiatal hernia
syn: GENERAL: Herniation of stomach through the oesophageal hiatus (sliding or paraoesophageal). Also called: Hiatus hernia

name: Submucosal edema
syn: GENERAL: Oedema of the bowel wall (submucosal oedema / target sign).

name: Cholecystitis
syn: GENERAL: Inflammation of the gallbladder (acute, gangrenous, emphysematous, perforated, empyema). Also called: Gallbladder inflammation

name: Cholelithiasis
syn: GENERAL: Calculi in the gallbladder (cholelithiasis), including gallstone-related complications. Also called: Gallstone; Gallstones

name: Surgically absent gallbladder
syn: GENERAL: Gallbladder absent after cholecystectomy. Also called: Cholecystectomized; Status post cholecystectomy

name: Abscess
syn: GENERAL: Walled-off infected collection of any organ (pelvic, hepatic, pulmonary, peritonsillar, appendiceal, soft tissue). Also called: suppurative inflammatory collection

name: Atrophy
syn: GENERAL: Volume loss of an organ or tissue (renal, hepatic, pancreatic, cerebral, muscle). Also called: Organ atrophy; Tissue atrophy

name: Cyst
syn: GENERAL: Cystic lesion of any organ (renal, hepatic, ovarian, splenic, pancreatic, cerebral, bone, skin). Also called: epithelial cyst

name: Diverticulum
syn: GENERAL: Outpouching of a hollow organ (bladder, duodenum, colon, small bowel, oesophagus, trachea, bronchus, calyx, stomach). Also called: Diverticula

name: Fluid collection
syn: GENERAL: Localised fluid collection of any kind (abscess, seroma, biloma, peripancreatic collection, pseudocyst, lymphocele). Also called: collection; loculated fluid

name: Foreign body
syn: GENERAL: Foreign material not placed for treatment (metal, glass, ocular, ingested, aspirated, gunshot fragments).

name: Haemorrhage
syn: GENERAL: Bleeding anywhere, including haematoma (intracranial, intrathoracic, abdominal, retroperitoneal, soft tissue, GI). Also called: Bleeding; Hemorrhage

name: Orbital abnormality
syn: GENERAL: Abnormality of the orbit or globe: proptosis, orbital fracture, extraocular muscle enlargement, globe calcification, orbital foreign body.

name: Aortic valve calcification
syn: GENERAL: Calcification of the aortic valve. Also called: Calcific aortic valve disease

name: Cardiac chamber enlargement
syn: GENERAL: Enlargement of one or more cardiac chambers (atrial or ventricular dilatation).

name: Cardiomegaly
syn: GENERAL: Enlarged heart (increased cardiothoracic ratio / cardiac chambers).

name: Congenital cardiovascular anomaly
syn: GENERAL: Congenital heart, great-vessel or coronary anomaly.

name: Congenital heart disease
syn: GENERAL: Congenital cardiac/great-vessel defect (ASD, VSD, PDA, bicuspid aortic valve, coarctation, anomalous venous return, double outlet RV).

name: Coronary artery anomaly
syn: GENERAL: Congenital coronary artery variant/anomaly (origin, course, hypoplasia, duplication, fistula, myocardial bridging). Also called: Congenital coronary artery anomalies

name: Pericardial effusion
syn: GENERAL: Fluid in the pericardial sac (including haemopericardium).

name: Valvular calcification
syn: GENERAL: Calcification of cardiac valves or mitral annulus.

name: Tuberculosis
syn: GENERAL: Tuberculosis of any site (pulmonary primary/post-primary, endobronchial, pleural, extrapulmonary, ileocaecal). Also called: Consumption; Phthisis; TB

name: Congenital renal anomaly
syn: GENERAL: Congenital renal variant: horseshoe, ectopic, crossed-fused, malrotation, duplex system, hypoplasia.

name: Hydronephrosis
syn: GENERAL: Dilatation of the renal collecting system (any grade), including hydroureteronephrosis. Also called: Chronic hydronephrosis; Dilatation of the urinary collecting system

name: Nephrocalcinosis
syn: GENERAL: Calcification of the renal parenchyma (medullary, cortical). Also called: Albright calcinosis; Anderson-Carr kidney

name: Pyelonephritis
syn: GENERAL: Infection of the kidney (acute, chronic, emphysematous). Also called: Renal pelvis and parenchymal infection

name: Renal calculus
syn: GENERAL: Calculus within the kidney (pyelolithiasis, nephrolithiasis, staghorn). Also called: kidney stone; renal stone; nephrolithiasis; stone in the kidney

name: Renal cyst
syn: GENERAL: Cyst of the kidney (simple, cortical, parapelvic/sinus, hyperdense, complex, polycystic, acquired cystic disease). Also called: Cystic renal lesion; Renal epithelial cyst; Simple renal cyst

name: Renal hypodensities
syn: GENERAL: Hypodense renal lesions (cysts or indeterminate hypoattenuating lesions).

name: Renal mass
syn: GENERAL: Solid or complex renal mass / neoplasm (RCC, angiomyolipoma, oncocytoma, urothelial of the upper tract). Also called: Kidney mass; Renal neoplasm

name: Renal parenchymal disease
syn: GENERAL: Diffuse renal parenchymal change: chronic kidney disease, enlargement or hypertrophy, atrophy, oedema, cortical scarring.

name: Chronic liver disease
syn: GENERAL: Chronic liver parenchymal disease, including cirrhosis.

name: Focal liver lesion
syn: GENERAL: Any focal liver lesion: cyst, haemangioma, FNH, adenoma, abscess, metastasis, HCC, other tumour or indeterminate hypodense lesion.

name: Hepatic steatosis
syn: GENERAL: Diffuse fatty infiltration of the liver (decreased liver attenuation), any cause. Also called: Hepatosteatosis; fatty liver

name: Hepatomegaly
syn: GENERAL: Enlarged liver. Also called: Enlarged liver

name: Portal hypertension
syn: GENERAL: Portal hypertension or its signs: portosystemic collaterals, gastric/oesophageal varices, spontaneous splenorenal shunt. Also called: Portal hypertensive vasculopathy

name: Atelectasis
syn: GENERAL: Loss of lung volume from incomplete aeration (linear/plate-like, subsegmental, segmental, lobar collapse, compressive, passive, round). Also called: Lung atelectasis; adhesive atelectasis; cicatrisation atelectasis; compressive atelectasis; discoid atelectasis; linear atelectasis; lung collapse; passive atelectasis

name: Bronchiectasis
syn: GENERAL: Irreversible bronchial dilatation (cylindrical, varicose, cystic, traction); excludes bronchiolectasis. Also called: bronchiectases

name: Consolidation
syn: GENERAL: Airspace filling that obscures vessels (lobar, segmental or patchy consolidation, pneumonic consolidation). Also called: Airspace opacification; Alveolar consolidation; Lung consolidation; Pulmonary consolidation

name: Cystic lung lesion
syn: GENERAL: Thin-walled air-containing lung spaces: bulla, bleb, pulmonary cyst, pneumatocele, cystic lung disease. Also called: Diffuse cystic lung disease; Cystic lung disease

name: Emphysema
syn: GENERAL: Permanent destruction of alveolar walls with airspace enlargement (centrilobular, paraseptal, panlobular, paracicatricial). Also called: Pulmonary emphysema

name: Ground-glass opacity
syn: GENERAL: Hazy increased lung attenuation with preserved vessels and bronchi (not a discrete nodule).

name: Interlobular septal thickening
syn: GENERAL: Thickening of the interlobular septa (smooth or nodular), including lymphangitic spread. Also called: Septal thickening

name: Interstitial lung disease
syn: GENERAL: Established interstitial lung disease; excludes incidental interstitial lung abnormality (ILA). Also called: ILD; diffuse lung disease

name: Lung mass
syn: GENERAL: Morphological: pulmonary lesion > 3 cm. Remove lung cancer/bronchogenic terms from its regex. Also called: Pulmonary mass

name: Lung opacity
syn: GENERAL: Any abnormal increase in lung parenchymal attenuation: consolidation, ground-glass opacity, pneumonic infiltrate, oedema, haemorrhage or contusion.

name: Mosaic attenuation pattern
syn: GENERAL: Patchwork of regions of differing lung attenuation (small-airways or vascular), including air trapping described as mosaic. Also called: Mosaic attenuation

name: Peribronchial thickening
syn: GENERAL: Thickening of bronchial walls / peribronchovascular interstitium. Also called: Bronchial wall thickening

name: Pneumonia
syn: GENERAL: Infectious airspace disease of the lung (any organism or pattern).

name: Pulmonary cavity
syn: GENERAL: Gas-filled space within a lung lesion or consolidation. Also called: Cavitary lesion

name: Pulmonary fibrotic sequela
syn: GENERAL: Fibrotic scarring of the lung: parenchymal bands, reticulation, focal/diffuse fibrosis, honeycombing, traction bronchiectasis, radiation fibrosis. Also called: Parenchymal sequelae; Pulmonary sequelae; Sequelae; Pleuroparenchymal sequelae

name: Pulmonary infection
syn: GENERAL: Infection of the lung parenchyma or airways (pneumonia, tuberculosis, fungal, mycobacterial, infectious bronchiolitis). Also called: Lung infection

name: Pulmonary nodule
syn: GENERAL: Discrete rounded lung opacity up to 3 cm (solid, part-solid, ground-glass, calcified, micronodules, metastatic nodules). Also called: Lung nodule; Pulmonary nodules

name: Radiation-induced lung disease
syn: GENERAL: Radiation pneumonitis or post-radiation fibrosis. Also called: RILD; radiation fibrosis; radiation pneumonitis

name: Sarcoidosis
syn: GENERAL: Sarcoidosis (thoracic or systemic). Also called: Systemic sarcoidosis

name: Small airways disease
syn: GENERAL: Bronchiolar disease (bronchiolitis of any type, constrictive bronchiolitis); air trapping is a separate sign. Also called: bronchiolitis

name: Lymphadenopathy
syn: GENERAL: Pathologically enlarged or abnormal lymph nodes at any station (mediastinal, hilar, axillary, cervical, abdominal, pelvic), including nodal metastases. Also called: Lymph node enlargement; Lymphadenomegaly

name: Mediastinal/hilar lymphadenopathy
syn: GENERAL: Enlarged mediastinal or hilar lymph nodes.

name: Mediastinal mass
syn: GENERAL: Mass or abnormal soft tissue in the mediastinum (anterior, visceral, thymic). Also called: Mediastinal lesion; Mediastinal tumor

name: Goitre
syn: GENERAL: Enlarged thyroid gland (diffuse, multinodular, substernal). Also called: Thyroid enlargement; Thyromegaly

name: Salivary gland disease
syn: GENERAL: Salivary gland abnormality: sialadenitis, sialolithiasis, gland enlargement, parotid/submandibular lesions.

name: Thyroid disease
syn: GENERAL: Any thyroid abnormality: nodule, goitre, thyroiditis, heterogeneity, calcification, carcinoma.

name: Thyroid nodule
syn: GENERAL: Nodule or nodular goitre of the thyroid. Also called: incidental thyroid nodule; solitary thyroid nodule; thyroid incidentaloma; thyroid nodular disease

name: Metastatic disease
syn: GENERAL: Metastatic malignancy anywhere (lung, liver, bone, brain, adrenal, peritoneal, pleural, nodal, skin, lymphangitic).

name: Primary malignancy
syn: GENERAL: Named primary malignant neoplasm of any organ (carcinoma, sarcoma, lymphoma, mesothelioma, GIST, HCC, RCC...).

name: Adrenal abnormality
syn: GENERAL: Any adrenal imaging abnormality: nodule/mass, hyperplasia, enlargement, calcification.

name: Airway dilatation
syn: GENERAL: Abnormal dilatation of bronchi or bronchioles (bronchiectasis, bronchiolectasis).

name: Biliary tract abnormality
syn: GENERAL: Any abnormality of the bile ducts/biliary tree: dilatation, obstruction, cholangitis, pneumobilia, bile-duct neoplasm, biloma.

name: Breast abnormality
syn: GENERAL: Any breast abnormality: mass, calcification, skin thickening, cancer, gynaecomastia.

name: Craniovertebral junction anomaly
syn: GENERAL: Congenital or acquired abnormality of the occiput-C1-C2 junction.

name: Dental / periodontal abnormality
syn: GENERAL: Abnormality of the teeth or periodontium.

name: Gallbladder abnormality
syn: GENERAL: Any gallbladder abnormality (stones, inflammation, perforation, wall thickening, polyp, adenomyomatosis, distension, sludge, porcelain GB).

name: Hepatobiliary parasitic infection
syn: GENERAL: Parasitic infection of the liver or bile ducts (hydatid, schistosomiasis, clonorchiasis, fascioliasis).

name: Infarction
syn: GENERAL: Ischaemic tissue infarction of any organ (kidney, spleen, lung, myocardium, omentum).

name: Joint disease
syn: GENERAL: Any abnormality of a (non-spinal) synovial joint: arthritis/arthropathy of any cause, effusion, dislocation/instability, joint-space narrowing, subchondral cyst.

name: Nasal cavity abnormality
syn: GENERAL: Abnormality of the nasal cavity: septal perforation/spur, stenosis, synechia, turbinate hypertrophy.

name: Pancreatic abnormality
syn: GENERAL: Any pancreatic abnormality: parenchymal disease, neoplasm, ductal dilatation or stone, congenital anomaly.

name: Parasitic infection
syn: GENERAL: Helminthic/parasitic infection of any organ.

name: Peritoneal abnormality
syn: GENERAL: Any peritoneal/omental abnormality: peritonitis, thickening/nodularity, omental cake, pseudomyxoma, adhesions, loose body, omental infarction.

name: Pharyngeal/tonsillar disease
syn: GENERAL: Abnormality of the pharynx or Waldeyer's ring lymphoid tissue.

name: Pleural abnormality
syn: GENERAL: Any pleural abnormality: effusion, thickening/plaque, adhesions, retraction, malignant pleural disease, pneumothorax.

name: Prostate disease
syn: GENERAL: Any prostate abnormality: enlargement, calcification, inflammation or neoplasm.

name: Schistosomiasis
syn: GENERAL: Schistosoma infection of any organ (liver, lung, urinary tract).

name: Situs / laterality anomaly
syn: GENERAL: Abnormal left-right arrangement of thoraco-abdominal organs (situs inversus, heterotaxy/isomerism).

name: Spinal canal or foraminal stenosis
syn: GENERAL: Narrowing of the spinal canal, lateral recess or neural foramen of any cause (degenerative, congenital, neoplastic, traumatic).

name: Temporal bone abnormality
syn: GENERAL: Any abnormality of the temporal bone, middle ear, mastoid or external auditory canal (otomastoiditis, cholesteatoma, tympanosclerosis, mastoid sclerosis, TM abnormality).

name: Tympanic membrane abnormality
syn: GENERAL: Abnormality of the tympanic membrane: perforation, retraction, thickening, myringosclerosis.

name: Urinary bladder abnormality
syn: GENERAL: Any urinary bladder abnormality: inflammation, wall thickening/trabeculation, calculus, diverticulum, hernia, neoplasm.

name: Uterine abnormality
syn: GENERAL: Any uterine abnormality: mass/neoplasm, enlargement, calcification, endometrial thickening or fluid.

name: Venous stenosis or occlusion
syn: GENERAL: Narrowing, compression or occlusion of a vein or dural venous sinus.

name: Pancreatic atrophy
syn: GENERAL: Reduced pancreatic volume / parenchymal atrophy. Also called: Fatty replacement of the pancreas

name: Pancreatic neoplasms
syn: GENERAL: Pancreatic tumour of any kind (adenocarcinoma, IPMN, serous/mucinous cystic neoplasm, neuroendocrine, lipoma). Also called: Pancreatic tumors

name: Pancreatic parenchymal disease
syn: GENERAL: Pancreatic parenchymal change, diffuse or focal: fatty infiltration, atrophy, calcification, pancreatitis.

name: Pancreatitis
syn: GENERAL: Acute or chronic pancreatic inflammation (oedematous, necrotising, gallstone, mass-forming chronic). Also called: Inflammation of the pancreas

name: Adnexal lesion
syn: GENERAL: Ovarian or adnexal cyst or mass.

name: Uterine mass or neoplasm
syn: GENERAL: Uterine mass: leiomyoma, lipoleiomyoma, endometrial carcinoma. Also called: Uterine mass

name: Ascites
syn: GENERAL: Free fluid in the peritoneal cavity (any amount). Also called: Free intraperitoneal fluid; free peritoneal fluid; hydroperitoneum

name: Mesenteric abnormality
syn: GENERAL: Mesenteric fat stranding/oedema, panniculitis, sclerosing mesenteritis, mesenteric ischaemia or lymphadenitis.

name: Pneumoperitoneum
syn: GENERAL: Free intraperitoneal gas (pneumoperitoneum), including postoperative. Also called: Free air

name: Pleural effusion
syn: GENERAL: Fluid in the pleural space of any type or side (simple, bilateral, parapneumonic, haemothorax, empyema, malignant). Also called: Large unilateral pleural effusion

name: Pleural thickening
syn: GENERAL: Pleural thickening, plaques or calcification (including asbestos-related pleural disease, fibrothorax, pleural metastases/mesothelioma). Also called: Focal pleural thickening; Pleural fibrosis

name: Pneumothorax
syn: GENERAL: Air in the pleural space (including tension pneumothorax). Also called: PTX; pleural air; spontaneous pneumothorax; tension pneumothorax; traumatic pneumothorax

name: Post-surgical state
syn: GENERAL: Status after surgery: organ resection (…ectomy), transplant, craniotomy/laminectomy/sternotomy, stoma, anastomosis, resection/ablation site.

name: Status post lung resection
syn: GENERAL: Prior resection of lung tissue (wedge, segmentectomy, lobectomy, pneumonectomy).

name: Prostatomegaly
syn: GENERAL: Enlarged prostate gland. Also called: Prostate enlargement; Prostate hypertrophy; Prostatic hypertrophy

name: Paranasal sinus disease
syn: GENERAL: Paranasal sinus disease or opacification of any cause (inflammatory, fungal, inspissated secretions, haemosinus, antrolith/intrasinus calcification, retention cysts, polyps).

name: Sinonasal anatomical variant
syn: GENERAL: Sinonasal developmental variant (septal deviation, concha bullosa, sinus hypoplasia, Haller/Onodi cell).

name: Anasarca
syn: GENERAL: Generalised subcutaneous and body-wall oedema. Also called: generalized edema

name: Soft tissue oedema
syn: GENERAL: Oedema/swelling of subcutaneous or soft tissues (local or generalised, including anasarca). Also called: Soft tissue edema; Subcutaneous Edema

name: Degenerative spine disease
syn: GENERAL: Degenerative changes of the spine: spondylosis, osteophytes, disc degeneration/herniation, osteochondrosis, facet arthropathy, vacuum phenomenon, Schmorl nodes.

name: Spinal curvature abnormality
syn: GENERAL: Abnormal spinal curvature: scoliosis, kyphosis, kyphoscoliosis, loss or increase of lordosis.

name: Spinal fracture
syn: GENERAL: Fracture of any vertebra (compression, burst, wedge, pathological). Also called: Spinal column fracture; Vertebral fracture

name: Spinal ligament ossification
syn: GENERAL: Ossification of spinal ligaments: OPLL, ligamentum flavum ossification, DISH.

name: Spondylolisthesis
syn: GENERAL: Slippage of one vertebral body on another (antero-/retrolisthesis).

name: Splenomegaly
syn: GENERAL: Enlarged spleen. Also called: Spleen enlargement; Spleenomegaly; enlarged spleen

name: Otomastoiditis
syn: GENERAL: Middle ear / mastoid inflammatory disease (otitis media, mastoiditis, cholesteatoma, opacification). Also called: Acute otomastoiditis; Otitis media with mastoiditis

name: Urinary tract dilatation
syn: GENERAL: Dilatation of the collecting system and/or ureter (hydronephrosis, hydroureter, obstructive uropathy, megaureter).

name: Urolithiasis
syn: GENERAL: Calculi anywhere in the urinary tract (kidney, ureter, bladder). Also called: Bladder stones; Renal tract calculi; Ureteral stones; Urinary tract calculi

name: Accessory ossicle
syn: GENERAL: Accessory ossicle or sesamoid variant.

name: Anatomical variant
syn: GENERAL: Normal anatomical variant; kept for completeness but not a pathology.

name: Hepatic vascular variant
syn: GENERAL: Normal variant of hepatic arteries, portal or hepatic veins.

name: Jugular bulb variant
syn: GENERAL: Developmental variant of the jugular bulb (high-riding, dehiscent, diverticulum).

name: Persistent embryonic artery
syn: GENERAL: Persistence of a fetal artery (trigeminal, hypoglossal, stapedial, sciatic).

name: Renal vascular variant
syn: GENERAL: Normal variant of renal arteries or veins.

name: Vertebral developmental variant
syn: GENERAL: Segmentation/fusion developmental variant of the spine.

name: Abdominal aortic aneurysm
syn: GENERAL: Aneurysmal dilatation of the abdominal aorta (including inflammatory AAA). Also called: AAA

name: Acute aortic syndrome
syn: GENERAL: Aortic dissection, intramural haematoma or penetrating atherosclerotic ulcer.

name: Aneurysm
syn: GENERAL: Focal arterial dilatation of any vessel (aortic, intracranial, visceral, coronary, iliac; true or pseudoaneurysm). Also called: arterial dilatation; vascular aneurysm

name: Aortic dilatation
syn: GENERAL: Dilatation or aneurysm of the thoracic or abdominal aorta (root, ascending, arch, descending, abdominal).

name: Arterial stenosis or occlusion
syn: GENERAL: Narrowing or occlusion of an artery (carotid, renal, mesenteric, subclavian, intracranial large/medium vessel, coarctation).

name: Arterial wall calcification
syn: GENERAL: Calcification in the wall of any artery (aorta, coronary, carotid, iliac, intracranial, visceral). Also called: Arterial calcification; Vascular calcification

name: Atherosclerosis
syn: GENERAL: Atherosclerotic disease of any artery: calcified or non-calcified plaque, arteriosclerosis, atherosclerotic stenosis/occlusion, coronary artery disease. Also called: Arteriosclerosis; Arteriolosclerosis; Mönckeberg medial calcific sclerosis

name: Coronary artery calcification
syn: GENERAL: Calcification of the coronary arteries (CT-RATE: coronary artery wall calcification). Also called: Coronary artery wall calcification; Coronary calcification; CAC

name: Coronary artery disease
syn: GENERAL: Coronary atherosclerotic disease (plaque, stenosis) — includes coronary calcification. Also called: Coronary artery atherosclerosis; CAD; Coronary atherosclerosis; Stable coronary artery disease

name: Pulmonary artery enlargement
syn: GENERAL: Dilatation of the pulmonary trunk or pulmonary arteries.

name: Pulmonary embolism
syn: GENERAL: Embolic filling defect in pulmonary arteries (acute or chronic, any extent). Also called: PE

name: Pulmonary hypertension
syn: GENERAL: Pulmonary hypertension of any group (including CTEPH, PH with COPD, cor pulmonale).

name: Thrombosis
syn: GENERAL: Thrombus in any vessel or cardiac chamber: venous thrombosis, DVT, pulmonary embolism, portal/splenic/mesenteric vein thrombosis, intracardiac thrombus.
